title: Portuguese Chicken Bake
description: A flavorful chicken bake inspired by traditional Portuguese cuisine. This recipe combines tender chicken with spices and herbs for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Place the bake in the oven and preheat for 5 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and brush it with olive oil.
Place the chicken breast on the bake and garnish with fresh rosemary.
Return the bake to the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
